gold.$description: Sampled from the master logo (lorven logo-01.svg, gold gradient on the E; mid stop). Brand surfaces only (studio shell, cover, marketing); never an interface state.

gold-deep.$description: Sampled from the master logo gold gradient (dark end). Brand surfaces on light grounds where brand-gold lacks contrast.

orange.$description: Sampled from the master logo (STUDIO gradient start). Brand surfaces only; never a status or action colour.

red.$description: Sampled from the master logo (STUDIO gradient end). Brand surfaces only; never error or destructive.

cyan.$description: Sampled from the four product lockups (icon disc). Belongs to the official marks; the UI's own interaction colour is the deeper cine ramp on the same hue.

space-2.$description: Gap between inline controls; chip padding-x.

radius-sm.$description: Compact controls: chips, menu and nav items, segmented items, checkboxes' outer radius family.

radius-md.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects — the standard control radius.

radius-lg.$description: Cards, panels, menus, composer, review surfaces.

radius-xl.$description: Dialogs, command menu and large workspace containers only.

radius-full.$description: Avatars, switches, status dots and count badges — never buttons or nav items.

target-min.$description: Minimum pointer target (WCAG 2.5.8); icon buttons pad to this.

icon-sm.$description: Icons in chips, captions, dense rows.

icon-stroke.$description: Icon stroke at 24px; the sprite scales it, so 16px renders ≈1px.

bp-wide.$description: ≥1200px: overview with side activity column; review shows source and match side by side.

sans.$description: Primary face of the sans stack. Full CSS stack: Switzer, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

brand.$description: Primary face of the brand stack. Full CSS stack: Nexa, Switzer, sans-serif

script.$description: Primary face of the script stack. Full CSS stack: "Courier Prime", "Courier New", Courier, monospace

mono.$description: Primary face of the mono stack. Full CSS stack: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace
